obfuscation_indicators: believes that revenue generating sources are sufficient
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly detailed and quantifies transactions, repayment schedules, note balances, and equity investments, but its dense legal structure and some forward-looking assertions reduce transparency. Historical credit stress is evident from repeated forbearance extensions and reliance on negotiated repayments, although the Second A&R Note was ultimately paid in full and the company reports sufficient funding sources.
